messages.subject: Rattle 3.3.0 now on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
The latest release of Rattle <http://rattle.togaware.com>, version 3.3.0, is now available on CRAN <http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/index.html>.

This release includes
Quite a few updates in the migration from base graphics to ggplot2
Many bug fixes, including xlsx import on Microsoft Windows
Execute on the Log tab will execute the entire contents of the Log tab
much more.... see the NEWS  <http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/NEWS>

R <http://www.r-project.org> continues to grow as the platform of choice for the data scientist. Rattle <http://rattle.togaware.com> is a freely available and open source graphical user interface for Data Mining using R <http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/1441998896/ref=as_li_qf_sp_asin_tl?ie=UTF8&tag=togaware-20&linkCode=as2&camp=217145&creative=399373&creativeASIN=1441998896>, wrapping up the use of over 100 R packages that together provide the most popular algorithms for the Data Scientist.

Rattle is used widely by Data Scientists across industry and by many independent consultants. It is also used for teaching the concepts of Machine Learning and Data Mining, and as a pathway into the full power of R for the Data Scientist -  an important feature of Rattle is that all functionality accessed via the graphical user interface is captured as a structured R script that can be run independently of Rattle to repeat every step performed by Rattle. In addition to being a useful tool for learning R it transparently supports repeatability of all activity in scripts that can extended or automatically be run at a later time.

The related popular text book Data Mining with Rattle and R <http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/1441998896/ref=as_li_qf_sp_asin_tl?ie=UTF8&tag=togaware-20&linkCode=as2&camp=217145&creative=399373&creativeASIN=1441998896> is available from Amazon.

Rattle version 3.3.0 is available on CRAN <http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/index.html>. Rattle is regularly updated with new user supplied features and bug fixes and the latest beta versions are always available from within R:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Also note that feature requests and bug fixes are now captured and voted on and resolved using the new Connect-R <http://www.connect-r.com/> service where users are encouraged to nominate features they would like to see in Rattle. Such requests are then put up to the community for implementation.

Regards,
Graham

messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm using R version 3.1.1 and Rattle 3.1.0, on Windows 7, 64-bit machine. I started my Rattle as usual.  Then, in attempting to readHTMLTable() to duplicate the result with the R code on page 90 of the Rattle book, as reproduced below, I got an error. Can anyone please explain what went wrong?  Thanks.

Charlie

> library(rattle)
Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.
Version 3.1.0 Copyright (c) 2006-2014 Togaware Pty Ltd.
Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
> rattle()

> library(XML)
> google <- "http://www.google.com/"
> path <- "adplanner/static/top1000/"
> top1000urls <- paste(google, path, sep=" ")

> tables <- readHTMLTable(top1000urls)

Error: failed to load HTTP resource

messages.subject_clean: MAC OS rattle error Gtk-WARNING: No such file or directory
messages.body_plain:
Hey all,

I am new rattle.
Everything seems to be okay when I install rattle.
But when I try to import the data to rattle, it show me a error message about Gtk-WARNINIG as below:

(R:5440): Gtk-WARNING **: Attempting to store changes into `/Users/Grace/.local/share/recently-used.xbel', but failed: Failed to create file '/Users/Grace/.local/share/recently-used.xbel.0YKZMX': No such file or directory

(R:5440): Gtk-WARNING **: Attempting to set the permissions of `/Users/Grace/.local/share/recently-used.xbel', but failed: No such file or directory

I check something online. And I have tried to update my X11. Install rattle from the source (install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source”)). install RGtk2. (install.packages("RGtk2", depen=T)).

I have tried both in r and Rstudio.

But it keeps giving me the same error message.

My rattleInfo is
Rattle: version 3.3.1 cran 3.3.0
R: version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)

What can I do? Really appreciate the help.

Best Regards.

Grace
